entries.title: ADR-0001 — Zero-dependency, local-first architecture
entries.useWhen: You are tempted to add a framework, package or server component.
entries.description: Decision to build Atlas as a zero-dependency static site with all state in localStorage — and what it costs us.

entries.title: ADR-0002 — Markdown-canonical docs with generated HTML/JSON counterparts
entries.useWhen: You are changing how documentation is written, built or validated.
entries.description: Decision to adopt the Lehro house docs pattern (Polaris MVP / LEHRO BMS): .md as source of truth, generated themed .html and machine-readable .json, gated by docs:check.

entries.title: Architecture

entries.title: Contributing
